name: color_tools
description: Convert colours between hex, RGB, HSL, HSV and CMYK, compute the WCAG 2.x relative luminance and contrast ratio of two colours with AA/AAA verdicts for normal text, large text and UI components, find the nearest CSS named colours (CIELAB delta E), and build palettes from a seed: complementary, triadic, analogous, split-complementary, tetradic, tints and shades. Reads hex, rgb(), hsl(), hsv(), cmyk() and the 148 CSS named colours.

color.description: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), hsl(), hsv(), cmyk(), a CSS name, or {r, g, b, a}

catalog.source: WCAG 2.2 (W3C) definitions of relative luminance and contrast ratio, success criteria 1.4.3, 1.4.6 and 1.4.11; CSS Color Module Level 4 (W3C) named colours and HSL conversion; IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB; CIE 1976 L*a*b*
